state.description: Current state of the issuance flow

role.description: Role of this agent in the exchange

credentialDefinitionId.description: AnonCreds credential definition identifier, if the agent knows it

schemaId.description: AnonCreds schema identifier, if the agent knows it

claims.description: The offered attributes. The list is empty if the agent cannot read the offer.

errorMessage.description: Error message on the exchange. The agent sets it if the flow stops.

updatedAt.description: When the flow was last updated

404.description: No credential exchange with the given id
